title: Stocks To Surge 40%, Then Crash 80%—10-Year Yield To 0% | David Hunter
speaker: David Hunter (Contrarian Macro Advisors)

macro_themes.view: The 44-year secular bull market ends with a parabolic run (S&P ~10,000) in Q4 2026/Q1 2027.
Leverage (debt, derivatives, private credit, possibly Japan/China/Europe) triggers a bust bigger than 2008-09 with up to 80% equity declines and deflation.
Bond bear sentiment is extreme; yields are near a double top with 2007 and a big bond bull market is next.
Recent hike is likely one-and-done, at most two-and-done.
Oil has peaked after the Iran war; flows recovering, Iran cornered.
Moves to 2% and deflation in the bust over the next 18 months.
Has peaked; possible bounce on lower rates but hit hard in the bust.
JGB yield breakout is a wild card that could crack over 12-18 months.
